subject: general
question: Which British governor ended the Dual System of Government in Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Warren Hastings**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Warren Hastings was the 1st Governor-General of Bengal.
 
• In the Dual System, the company had Diwani rights (rights to collect revenue) and the Nizam or Indian chiefs had the administrative authority.
 
• Hastings abolished the Dual System<
